# Grid (ongrid)

> Reads, measures, checks, draws and changes floor plans kept in one plan file. Grid is an open-source (Apache-2.0) toolkit for AI agents: a `grid` command and an MCP tool server (`grid_…` tools). Every report carries the label "General guidance, not your local rules"; no message says a plan complies or is approved. Not published to npm yet.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what Grid is, a quick start and the ways to install it in an agent
- [The guide for agents](docs/agent-guide.md): write a valid first plan rooms first, and the answers to what agents ask
- [The plan file](docs/plan-file.md): what a plan file may hold and what each drawing check's code means
- [The tool server](docs/tool-server.md): every `grid_…` tool, asking across parts by their facts, protocol versions
- [Sample plans](docs/samples): a flat, a two-storey house and an open-plan home, as rooms text and as plan files

## Optional

- [Commands](docs/commands.md): every `grid` command with its options
- [Rooms first](docs/rooms-first.md): the whole rooms language
